goal: UNI-2926: sandcastle-runner uses the pinned @ai-hero/sandcastle@0.12.0 run() API via scripts/sandcastle_run.ts; no bare npx sandcastle run

criteria.text: no 'npx sandcastle run' / bare 'npx sandcastle init' remains in the runner skill, bootstrap script or manifests
criteria.recipe: ! git grep -nE 'npx sandcastle (run|init)' -- skills/sandcastle-runner scripts/sandcastle-bootstrap.sh agentskills.json agentskills.yaml

criteria.text: bootstrap pins @ai-hero/sandcastle@0.12.0, no 0.5.7 left, and parses as bash
criteria.recipe: grep -q '@ai-hero/sandcastle@0.12.0' scripts/sandcastle-bootstrap.sh && ! grep -q '0\.5\.7' scripts/sandcastle-bootstrap.sh && bash -n scripts/sandcastle-bootstrap.sh

criteria.text: scripts/sandcastle_run.ts typechecks (tsc --strict) against the real @ai-hero/sandcastle@0.12.0 types
criteria.recipe: cp scripts/sandcastle_run.ts /tmp/sc012/ && cd /tmp/sc012 && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --skipLibCheck --types node sandcastle_run.ts

criteria.text: with the hard-stop kill-switch file present, the runner prints status=killed JSON and exits 3 before any setup
criteria.recipe: cp scripts/sandcastle_run.ts /tmp/sc012/ && cd /tmp/sc012 && touch hs.flag && printf '{"cwd":".","prompt":"x","model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","sandbox":"noSandbox"}' > cfg.json && TAO_HARD_STOP_FILE=$PWD/hs.flag npx --no-install tsx sandcastle_run.ts cfg.json > out.json; test $? -eq 3 && grep -q '"status":"killed"' out.json
cat agentskills.json agentskills.yaml | sha256sum > /tmp/as_before && python -m swarm.agentskills_manifest >/dev/null && cat agentskills.json agentskills.yaml | sha256sum | cmp -s - /tmp/as_before

criteria.text: vercel-env-puller states agent env and sandbox env key sets must be disjoint
file-length lint passes with the new .ts file staged
